summary.text: Michael Lee is a Republican member of the North Carolina State Senate who represents District 7 and serves as Senate Majority Leader; he is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Michael Lee, whose full name is Michael Vincent Lee, was born in Kingston, New York, in 1968, according to Wikipedia.
He holds a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill and a Juris Doctor degree from Wake Forest University, and as a lawyer he started his own law firm in 2012.
Lee was first appointed to the Senate in August 2014 to replace Thom Goolsby and was re-elected in 2016.
He lost to Democrat Harper Peterson in 2018 and defeated Peterson in a 2020 rematch.

The General Assembly's member page lists Lee as Senate Majority Leader for the 2025-2026 session, representing New Hanover County in District 7, and Wikipedia says he was elected majority leader in April 2025.
